explanation: Scottish clockmaker Alexander Bain patented a way to send images by telegraph wire in 1843, 33 years before Alexander Graham Bell's telephone patent.

claims.text: Alexander Bain received a British patent in 1843 for a way to send images over telegraph wires, usually counted as the first fax patent.
Alexander Graham Bell received the US patent for the telephone in 1876.
Alexander Bain was a Scottish clockmaker.
Bain's 1843 patent came 33 years before Bell's 1876 telephone patent.
